title: How to Build a Portfolio Website That Actually Gets You Interviews
transcript:
Let's talk about what hiring managers actually care about when looking at your portfolio:
They do not care about fancy animations if the site is slow or hard to navigate.
If an animation delays access to the content by 3 seconds, you are hurting yourself.
Prioritize speed and accessibility:
1. Fast first contentful paint (FCP under 1 second).
2. Keyboard navigation: every button and interactive card must have clear :focus-visible outlines.
3. Mobile responsiveness: more than 50% of recruiters will open your portfolio link on their phone during a commute or meeting. If the layout breaks or horizontal scrolls, you're out.
4. Test on real devices, not just the Chrome DevTools responsive toggle.
